'''Vivica''' (Japanese: '''ユリコ''' ''Yuriko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG126|Saved by the Beldum]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who competed in the [[Ever Grande Conference]].

Vivica was pitted against {{ho|Tyson}} during the first preliminary {{pkmn|battle}}. She sent her {{p|Persian}} to battle [[Tyson's Meowth]], who seemed very determined to defeat its [[Evolution|evolved]] form.

Unfortunately for Tyson, Vivica's Persian had the early advantage. Using attacks such as {{m|Water Pulse}} and {{m|Shadow Ball}}, it managed to weaken {{p|Meowth}}. Meowth, though, eventually gained the upper-hand and defeated it. However, even after Persian fainted, Tyson's Meowth ran up to Persian with its claws extended, prepared to finish it off for good, but Tyson quickly recalled it before anything could happen. Due to this loss, Vivica was eliminated from the tournament.
